sections.content: Use reported statements and questions to explain what someone meant. Expressions such as quiso decir que, quería saber si and según él help communicate an implied or indirect meaning.

items.spanish: Quiso decir que no estaba de acuerdo.
items.english: He meant that he did not agree.
She wanted to know if we could help.

items.spanish: Según ella, el mensaje era diferente.
items.english: According to her, the message was different.

sections.content: Report the intended meaning rather than repeating the original words when the exact wording is not important.
